answer.reason: Several verses give Ophel a deed of its own: a wall built round it by Manasseh and the Nethinims living there.

clauses.english: was encircled by a very high wall built by Manasseh
clauses.quote: compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height

doubts: 2KI 5:24 ("the tower") is marked but does not name Ophel in the King James text, so it was left out.
ISA 32:14 and MIC 4:8 are marked but speak of forts, towers and the tower of the flock without naming Ophel, so they were left out.
Jotham's building on the wall of Ophel (2CH 27:3) and the Tekoites repairing its wall (NEH 3:27) were omitted as minor works on the same wall.
